other_conditions: Applicant must have made unparalleled technical or professional contributions to society in their respective field
Applicant should be an acknowledged leader in their particular field with active engagement in research, technology development, and innovation
Applicant must conduct at least 2 visits per month with a maximum of 12 visits per year
Professionals are encouraged to visit at least three rural institutions per year
benefits_summary: Honorarium of ₹15,000 per day for full‑day interactions with faculty/students; travel and local hospitality arranged by the host institution.
